title: Annual Leave
content: Employees are entitled to 20 days of annual leave per year.

title: Working Hours
content: The standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM from Monday to Friday.

title: Work From Home
content: Eligible employees may work from home with prior approval from their manager.

title: Sick Leave
content: Employees can request sick leave when they are unable to work due to illness.

title: Notice Period
content: Employees must follow the applicable notice period when resigning.

title: Casual Leave
content: Employees are entitled to 12 days of casual leave per year for personal or urgent matters.

title: Maternity Leave
content: Eligible female employees can take up to 26 weeks of maternity leave according to company policy and applicable regulations.

title: Paternity Leave
content: Eligible employees can take 10 days of paternity leave following the birth or adoption of a child.

title: Bereavement Leave
content: Employees may take up to 5 days of bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member.

title: Public Holidays
content: Employees are entitled to holidays listed in the company's official annual holiday calendar.

title: Attendance Policy
content: Employees are expected to report to work on time and maintain regular attendance.

title: Late Arrival
content: Employees who expect to arrive late should inform their manager or supervisor as soon as possible.

title: Standard Working Hours
content: The standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM from Monday to Friday.

title: Lunch Break
content: Employees are provided with a one-hour lunch break during the working day.

title: Remote Work Policy
content: Eligible employees may work from home with prior approval from their manager.

title: Remote Work Eligibility
content: Employees may be eligible for remote work based on their role, performance, and business requirements.

title: Resignation Notice
content: Employees must serve the applicable notice period stated in their employment agreement when resigning.

title: Exit Process
content: Employees leaving the organization must complete the required exit formalities and return company property.

title: Salary Payment
content: Employee salaries are normally processed and paid on the last working day of each month.

title: Salary Slip
content: Employees can access their salary slips through the company's payroll or employee portal.

title: Overtime Policy
content: Employees who work beyond their scheduled working hours may be eligible for overtime compensation according to company policy.

title: Performance Review
content: Employee performance is reviewed periodically based on goals, responsibilities, and overall performance.

title: Employee Training
content: Employees may participate in training programs to improve their professional skills and job-related knowledge.

title: Code of Conduct
content: Employees are expected to behave professionally and respectfully toward colleagues, customers, and business partners.

title: Confidentiality
content: Employees must protect confidential company information and must not disclose it to unauthorized persons.

title: Compensation Components
content: Employee compensation may consist of fixed salary, variable pay, allowances, incentives, bonuses, and other components specified in the employment agreement.

title: Compensation Eligibility
content: Eligibility for compensation components such as incentives, allowances, and bonuses depends on the employee's role, employment category, and applicable company rules.

title: Salary Revision Cycle
content: Salary revisions may be conducted during designated organizational appraisal or compensation review cycles.

title: Salary Hike Criteria
content: Salary increases may be determined using factors such as individual performance, role responsibilities, business conditions, and applicable compensation guidelines.

title: Three Month Review
content: Employees may undergo a performance or employment review after three months when a three-month review is specified in their employment terms.

title: Six Month Review
content: Employees may undergo a performance or employment review after six months when a six-month review is specified in their employment terms.

title: Promotion Compensation
content: Employees promoted to positions with increased responsibilities may receive compensation changes according to applicable promotion guidelines.

title: Payroll Cycle
content: Employee payroll is processed on a monthly basis using approved salary, attendance, leave, and deduction information.

title: Bank Account Details
content: Employees must provide valid bank account information required for salary credit and must notify HR of changes through the approved process.

title: Payroll Deductions
content: Authorized deductions may include applicable taxes, statutory contributions, employee-approved deductions, or other deductions permitted under company policy.

title: Payroll Discrepancy
content: Employees who identify an error in their salary payment should raise the issue with the designated HR or payroll support team.

title: On Roll Employment
content: On-roll employees are directly employed by the organization under the terms and conditions specified in their employment agreement.

title: Payroll Cutoff
content: Attendance, leave, and other payroll inputs must be submitted or approved within the designated payroll cutoff period to be considered for the applicable payroll cycle.

title: Attendance Recording
content: Employees must record their daily attendance using the organization's designated attendance system.

title: Attendance Regularization
content: Employees must submit a regularization request when an attendance entry is missing, incorrect, or not recorded correctly.

title: Attendance Approval
content: Attendance regularization requests may require verification or approval from the employee's reporting manager.

title: Attendance Compliance
content: Employees are responsible for following assigned working schedules and maintaining accurate attendance records.

title: Attendance Reporting
content: Employees should promptly report attendance-related technical problems or discrepancies to the designated HR or support team.

title: Shift Assignment
content: Employees may be assigned to different shifts based on project schedules, operational requirements, customer requirements, or business needs.

title: Shift Allowance Eligibility
content: Employees assigned to eligible shifts may receive a shift allowance when the applicable allowance criteria are satisfied.

title: Shift Change Request
content: Employees who need a change to their assigned shift must submit a request through the approved shift management process.

title: Shift Handover
content: Employees working in shifts must complete required handover activities so that relevant work information is communicated to the next shift.

title: Recruitment Sources
content: Candidates may be sourced through employee referrals, job portals, campus recruitment, recruitment agencies, professional networks, and the company's career channels.

title: Resume Screening
content: Recruiters may review candidate resumes to determine whether education, experience, skills, and other qualifications match the requirements of an open position.

title: Fresher Screening
content: Fresher candidates may be evaluated using academic performance, projects, communication skills, problem-solving ability, aptitude, and role-related technical knowledge.

title: Aptitude Test
content: Recruitment aptitude assessments may evaluate quantitative reasoning, logical reasoning, verbal ability, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

title: Technical Assessment
content: Technical assessments may evaluate knowledge of programming, databases, algorithms, software concepts, tools, or technologies relevant to the position.

title: Technical Interview
content: Technical interviews may evaluate technical knowledge, project experience, problem-solving methods, coding ability, and role-specific expertise.

title: HR Interview Assessment
content: HR interviews may discuss communication, career interests, availability, employment expectations, behavioral competencies, and other job-related matters.

title: Candidate Documentation
content: Candidates selected for further recruitment stages may be required to submit specified educational, identity, employment, address, or other supporting documents.

title: Background Verification
content: The organization may verify candidate information such as education, previous employment, identity, or other relevant details using approved verification procedures.

title: Offer Letter
content: Selected candidates may receive an offer containing information about their position, compensation, joining date, employment terms, and applicable conditions.

title: Recruitment Approval
content: Final hiring decisions may require authorization from designated recruitment, HR, hiring manager, or business stakeholders.

title: Employee Referral Process
content: Employees may refer candidates for open positions through the organization's designated employee referral mechanism.

title: Campus Hiring
content: The organization may conduct recruitment drives through colleges, universities, placement cells, or other educational institutions.

title: Pre-Onboarding
content: Selected candidates may complete forms, document submission, verification, and other joining requirements before their official joining date.

title: Joining Formalities
content: New employees must complete the required joining formalities specified by HR on or after their joining date.

title: Employee Induction
content: New employees may attend an induction program introducing the organization, departments, policies, workplace practices, systems, and employee responsibilities.

title: Reporting Manager Introduction
content: New employees are introduced to their reporting manager and informed about their reporting structure and initial responsibilities.

title: System Provisioning
content: Employees may receive email accounts, application access, hardware, and other system resources required for their assigned role.

title: Probation Terms
content: Employees may be subject to a probation period according to the duration and conditions specified in their employment agreement.

title: Probation Confirmation
content: Confirmation after probation may depend on performance, attendance, conduct, role requirements, and completion of applicable evaluation procedures.

title: International Opportunities
content: Employees may be considered for international projects or opportunities when suitable business requirements and eligible opportunities are available.

title: International Assignment Requirements
content: Employees selected for international assignments must complete applicable travel, immigration, documentation, and company approval requirements.

title: Internal Job Opportunities
content: Employees may apply for eligible internal vacancies or career opportunities through the organization's internal recruitment process.

title: Employee Fun Activities
content: The organization may conduct recreational activities such as games, celebrations, contests, or informal events as part of employee engagement programs.

title: Team Building
content: Teams may participate in structured activities intended to improve collaboration, communication, and team interaction.

title: Employee Celebrations
content: The organization may conduct celebrations or recognition events for organizational milestones, festivals, achievements, or employee occasions.

title: Dress Code
content: Employees must follow the applicable dress requirements for their workplace, role, customer interactions, and organizational events.

title: Professional Appearance
content: Employees are expected to maintain a clean and professional appearance appropriate to their workplace and job responsibilities.

title: Data Integrity
content: Employees must ensure that business data they create or maintain remains accurate, complete, consistent, and protected from unauthorized alteration.

title: Data Access Control
content: Employees may access company systems and information only when they have appropriate authorization for their job responsibilities.

title: Data Modification
content: Employees must follow approved procedures and authorization requirements when creating, modifying, deleting, or correcting important company records.

title: Confidential Data Handling
content: Employees must protect confidential employee, customer, business, and company information from unauthorized disclosure or access.

title: ADP Team Responsibilities
content: The ADP team may manage designated HR administration and employee lifecycle processes according to the responsibilities assigned by the organization.

title: HR Support Channels
content: Employees should use the organization's designated HR support channel when requesting assistance with HR-related matters.

title: Employee Record Management
content: Employee employment records are maintained by authorized HR personnel according to organizational procedures and applicable requirements.

title: Employee Information Changes
content: Employees must notify HR through the approved process when personal or employment information requiring an update changes.

title: Induction Training
content: Induction training introduces new employees to required company processes, policies, systems, security practices, and workplace expectations.

title: Technical Skill Training
content: Employees may receive technical training related to their role, project technologies, tools, or changing business requirements.

title: Soft Skill Training
content: Employees may participate in programs covering communication, teamwork, leadership, presentation, time management, and other professional skills.

title: Mandatory Training
content: Employees assigned mandatory training must complete the required sessions and associated activities within the specified timeframe.

title: Performance Goals
content: Employees may be assigned measurable goals and role responsibilities by their reporting manager.

title: Performance Feedback
content: Managers may provide employees with feedback regarding achievements, responsibilities, development areas, and progress toward assigned goals.

title: Performance Improvement Plan
content: Employees who require structured performance improvement may be placed under a performance improvement process according to company procedures.

title: Probation Performance Review
content: Employee performance may be formally reviewed during probation before a decision regarding confirmation or other employment action is made.

title: Skill Development
content: Employees are encouraged to develop technical, professional, communication, and role-specific skills throughout their employment.

title: Certification Programs
content: Employees may participate in relevant certification programs when supported or approved according to applicable organizational guidelines.

title: Career Development
content: Employees may discuss career development goals, skill requirements, and potential growth paths with their reporting manager or HR.

title: Workplace Communication
content: Employees are expected to use professional and appropriate communication when interacting with colleagues, managers, customers, and business partners.

title: Workplace Etiquette
content: Employees should follow professional workplace etiquette including respectful communication, appropriate behavior, and consideration for colleagues.

title: Meeting Conduct
content: Employees attending official meetings are expected to participate professionally, follow meeting requirements, and complete assigned actions.

title: Employee Grievance
content: Employees may raise workplace concerns or grievances through the organization's designated HR grievance process.

title: Workplace Conflict
content: Employees experiencing workplace conflicts should use appropriate reporting or resolution channels rather than engaging in disruptive or inappropriate behavior.

title: Anti-Harassment
content: Employees are expected to maintain a workplace free from harassment and must report concerns through the designated organizational reporting mechanism.
